div.head: VI Atr 32.3
div.ab: ⁊ burhbota ⁊ bricbota aginne man georne on æghwilcon ende, ⁊ fyrdunga eac ⁊ scipfyrdunga ealswa, a þonne neod sy, swa swa man geræde for gemænelicre neode.
And burhbota ⁊ bricbota aginne man georne, and fyrdunga eac swa, á þonne þearf sy for gemǽnelicre neode.
⁊ burhbota ⁊ bricbota aginne man georne on æghwilcon ende ⁊ fyrdunga eac ⁊ scipfyrdunga ealswa, a þonne neod sy, swa swa man geræde for gemænelicre neode.
And burhbota and bricbota aginne man georne on æghwilcon ende, and fyrdunga eac and scipfyrdunga ealswa, a þonne neod sy, swa swa man geræde for gemænelicre neode.

Und Festungsherstellungen und Brückenherrichtungen unternehme man eifrig in jedem Bezirk und ferner Landwehrrüstung und Schiffswehr ebenfalls, immer wenn es nöthig ist, so wie wegen gemeinsamer Nothwendigkeit beschlossen wird.

And let the repair of fortifications and the repair of bridges be eagerly undertaken in every district, and military service and naval service likewise, whenever there is need, as shall be decided for the common need.

And the repairing of fortifications and of bridges shall be diligently undertaken on every side, and also the provision of military and naval forces, whenever the occasion demands, as may be ordered for our common need.

And improvements to fortifications and bridges are to be undertaken with care on all sides, and also the provisioning of the army and navy as the need arises, just as has been ordained for the common good.

note.seg: Bei Vorwiegen von Wall und Graben (s. Gl Burg 2. 5) kamen doch auch muri laut Paraphrase vor
Although rampart and ditch predominated (see Gl Burg 2. 5), muri also occurred, according to the Paraphrase
An der Flotte nimmt entweder das authentische Gesetz oder die Bearbeitung, auch laut 33f., besonderen Anteil, nur im ersteren Falle vielleicht in Zusammenhang mit der Rüstung von 1008; s. o. Einl. 4
Either the authentic law or the revision takes a special interest in the fleet, as 33f. also show; only in the former case perhaps in connexion with the armament of 1008; see above Introduction 4
Cf. V, 26, 1. The Latin paraphrase reads: Arcium muri, urbes, oppida, castella, civitates, pontes reparentur…vallis et fossis muniantur et circumvallentur.
